subject.title: fix(gateway): preserve pending replies on forced restart

question: Should forced gateway restart remain an immediate no-wait escape hatch, or should it intentionally wait up to 5 seconds to preserve pending replies?
rationale: The PR likely fixes the focused message-loss bug, but it changes operator-visible forced restart timing and the repository policy treats restart/default behavior as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept bounded forced restart
options.body: Treat a 5 second best-effort drain as the intended forced-restart contract, update help wording, and require live proof before merge.

options.title: Keep force immediate
options.body: Reject this PR shape and pursue another pending-reply recovery design that does not make `--force` wait.

options.title: Make behavior explicit
options.body: Add a separate strict/immediate restart path or option if maintainers need both no-wait and reply-preserving behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded forced restart
recommendation.body: Treat a 5 second best-effort drain as the intended forced-restart contract, update help wording, and require live proof before merge.
